apartments.description: Collection of multifamily unit-mix/rent rows attached to the comp, supporting per-unit pricing metrics for apartment sales.

askingPriceHigh.description: Upper end of the sale price range requested by the seller; most pertinent to portfolio sales.

askingPriceLow.description: Lower end of the sale price range requested by the seller; most pertinent to portfolio sales.

assessment.description: Assessed value (improved/land/total) from the tax authority for the comp, typically aggregated across transfer documents; supports valuation context.

auctionForSaleIds.description: Identifiers of auction for-sale listings associated with this comp, linking the sale to auction-sourced listings (e.g. Ten-X). Join on integer IDs.

belowMarketSaleReasons.description: Reasons the sale priced below market (e.g. correction deed, refinance, trust deed, related-party). These disqualify the comp from contact sync and affect comparability — exclude/flag accordingly.

buildingParkType.description: Type of building park for a portfolio sale; values include Business Park, Office Park, and Industrial Park.

capitalizationRateActual.description: Cap rate from actual in-place NOI over price (R = NOI / Value); lower cap = lower risk/higher price. In US/Canada CoStar captures Cap Rate; in the UK/France the same field carries Yield, which is inclusive of acquisition costs.

capitalizationRateProForma.description: Cap rate based on projected/pro-forma NOI rather than actual in-place income (R = NOI / Value); flag as a projection when reported. In UK/France this field carries Yield rather than Cap Rate.

contacts.description: Parties tied to the comp (buyers, sellers, brokers, preparers) with their roles; True vs Recorded distinguishes real parties from deed-name parties. Contacts sync only for a valid comp with a qualifying Buyer/Seller and no disqualifying below-market reason.

dateOffMarket.description: The date the for-sale item (Property, Land, or CondoUnit) was taken off the market, via sale or owner withdrawal.

dateOnMarket.description: The date the for-sale item (Property, Land, or CondoUnit) went on the market.

downPayment.description: Amount of money presented up front in a completed sale.

entities.description: Per-property/asset breakdown of what sold in the transaction; each entity carries allocated price and property-type-specific attributes. Filter to true-comp grain before aggregating.

escrowLengthInDays.description: Number of days elapsing between the date the property goes under contract (in escrow) and the date it settles (close of escrow).

forSaleIds.description: Identifiers of the for-sale listing records associated with this comp, linking the completed sale back to its marketing listings. Join on integer IDs.

grossIncomeMultiplier.description: (GIM) Ratio of sale price to gross scheduled income plus other income at sale (or projected first-year GSI); a price-to-income valuation multiplier.

grossRentMultiplier.description: (GRM) Multifamily valuation statistic: sale price relative to the property's gross monthly rent, used to gauge a reasonable price against the income generated.

id.description: Unique identifier of the sale comp record; the join/anchor key for a completed sale used as a comparable transaction.

isLandValueSale.description: Flag indicating the property(ies) sold for the value of the land.

isNoBuyerBroker.description: Explicitly indicates that no buyer broker was involved with the sale.

isNoListingBroker.description: Explicitly indicates that no listing broker was involved with the sale.

marketAssessment.description: Market (full-value) assessment figures (improvement/land/total) from the assessor, distinct from assessed value; valuation context for the comp.

monetaryUnit.description: Currency/monetary unit of the comp amounts.

notes.description: Collection of free-text research notes attached to the comp, often capturing the deal story/motivation behind the sale.

numberOfEntities.description: Count of properties/assets (entities) included in the sale transaction; >1 indicates a multi-property or portfolio sale where prices may be allocated.

partialInterestSalePercent.description: For a partial-interest sale, the percentage of the property that was sold; does not apply to all sales.

portfolioName.description: For a portfolio sale, the name of the portfolio.

portfolioType.description: Code classifying whether/how this sale is part of a multi-property portfolio transaction.

pricePerRoom.description: Sale price per room; applies only to hotel/hospitality properties.

pricePerUnit.description: Sale price per unit; applicable only to multi-family property and residential land.

proposedLandUse.description: Intended/best use of the land for a land-value sale (e.g. zoning/development intent); only meaningful when isLandValueSale is true.

saleConditions.description: Collection of conditions affecting the sale price/comparability (distressed, lease-up, business-value-included, etc.); surface when comparing comps.

saleFinancingType.description: Indicates whether or not the sale involved financing.

saleMethod.description: Method by which the sale was transacted (e.g. standard sale, auction); defaults to standard sale.

salePriceStatus.description: How the sale price was established: 3 Confirmed by a party to the sale; 5 FullValue, calculated from the transfer tax and not confirmed; 7 Unconfirmed, a regional form of FullValue; 2 Approximate, reported by the buyer or in a news article; 1 Affidavit or 4 Declaration, taken from the document recorded with the deed; 6 Mini, only one of price and size is public; 0 Unknown when no status is recorded. Carry it with soldForPrice.

saleType.description: Nature of the sale (e.g. Investment vs Owner/User). A core comparability dimension: investment sales (bought for income) vs owner/user sales surface different relevant fields and should be screened together when comparing comps.

soldDate.description: The date the property sold under the current sale; technically, the date the most recent deed on the property was recorded.

soldForPrice.description: Price for which the Property, Land, or CondoUnit sold. Disclosure/trust level varies (full amount stated on document, computed from transfer/excise tax, or non-disclosure), so always carry salePriceStatus.

transferDocuments.description: Collection of recorded transfer/deed documents underlying the sale, carrying recording details, taxes, and assessments.

verificationFields.description: Collection of per-field verification records indicating which comp fields were verified, by whom, and from which source.

verificationSources.description: Collection of sources used to verify the comp (e.g. broker, public record); supports field-level verification provenance.

apartmentDataSource.description: Source of the apartment unit data (e.g. multifamily research vs marketplace feed), indicating provenance.

avgUnitSizeSqFt.description: Average rentable area in square feet for this unit type; size context for rent and price comparisons.

maxEffectiveRent.description: Upper bound of effective monthly rent (asking adjusted for concessions) for this unit type; keep the effective flavor separate from asking rent when aggregating.

maxMonthlyRent.description: Upper bound of asking monthly rent for this unit type; asking-flavor rent, normalize before aggregating.

maxOccupants.description: Maximum permitted occupants for this unit type.

minEffectiveRent.description: Lower bound of effective monthly rent (asking adjusted for concessions) for this unit type; keep the effective flavor distinct from asking rent before comparing.

minMonthlyRent.description: Lower bound of asking monthly rent for this unit type; normalize to $/SF/yr and keep the asking flavor distinct before comparing.

monthlyDiscount.description: Monthly rent discount/concession amount applied to this unit type, bridging asking and effective rent.

numBaths.description: Bathroom count for this unit type, fractional to allow half-baths; multifamily unit-mix attribute.

numBeds.description: Bedroom count of this unit type within the multifamily comp; primary unit-mix attribute.

numOccupantsVacant.description: Vacant occupancy capacity for this unit type (occupant slots unfilled); a multifamily occupancy detail.

numUnits.description: Number of units of this type in the property; drives the multifamily unit count and per-unit pricing.

numUnitsAvailable.description: Count of units of this type marketed as available; available is distinct from vacant and includes occupied/future-available units.

numUnitsVacant.description: Count of vacant (physically empty) units of this type at the property; vacancy is physical regardless of lease obligation.

propertyId.description: Foreign key to the property the apartment data belongs to; join on integer ID.

totalConcessionValue.description: Total monetary value of concessions offered on this unit type; reduces effective rent below asking.

improvedValue.description: Assessed value of the buildings and other improvements, excluding land.

landValue.description: Assessed value of the land alone.

improvedRatio.description: Share of the total assessed value attributed to improvements, as a fraction from 0 to 1.

contactFirstName.description: First name of the party as captured on the comp; free-text name used when the contact is not resolved to a Contact ID.

contactId.description: Id of the person in CoStar contact data.

contactLastName.description: Last name of the party as captured on the comp; free-text name fallback alongside the contact ID.

contactPhone.description: Phone number for the contact party to the sale; personal contact detail captured by research.

contactRole.description: Role of the person or company on this record, such as listing broker, buyer or seller.

funds.description: Collection of investment fund references tied to this party, linking the buyer/seller to the funds behind the transaction. Join on integer IDs.

locationId.description: The contact's location - the main work location of the contact.

locationName.description: Name of the company/location for the party as captured on the comp; free-text fallback when not resolved to a Location ID. Join on IDs, not names.

locationPhone.description: Phone number of the company/location party to the sale; contact detail captured by research.

percentOwned.description: Ownership percentage held by this buyer/seller party; summed across parties cannot exceed 100 and is bounded by the partial-interest sale percent.

allocatedPrice.description: Estimated price attributed to this individual asset within a multi-property/portfolio sale when the actual per-property price is unknown; a confidence-flagged modeled value (carry allocatedPriceStatus).

allocatedPriceStatus.description: How allocatedPrice was established. 8 Allocated means it is an estimated share of the portfolio price; the other values have the meanings given for salePriceStatus.

assetType.description: Type of the asset/entity in the sale (e.g. property, document); determines the grain and which fields apply. Filter on this before counting true comps.

averageRentalRate.description: Average rental rate for the asset at sale; income input for investment-sale valuation. Normalize flavor/type before comparing.

buildingFullName.description: Full name of the building/asset; hospitality-specific identifier used for hotel comps.

capitalizationRateActual.description: Actual (in-place NOI) cap rate for this individual asset (R = NOI / Value); core per-asset valuation metric. In UK/France this field carries Yield (inclusive of acquisition costs) rather than Cap Rate.

capitalizationRateProForma.description: Pro forma (projected-NOI) cap rate for this individual asset; flag as a projection when reported.

documentId.description: Foreign key to the transfer document associated with this entity, linking the asset to its recorded deed.

entityId.description: Id of the sold asset this entry describes; read it with assetType (a property, a condo unit or a rumored property).

hotelClass.description: Hotel class/tier of the asset (hospitality-specific); a benchmarking attribute for hotel sale comps, aligned to STR-style hospitality classification used in hospitality KPI calculations.

hotelOperationType.description: Hotel operating arrangement (e.g. franchise, managed, independent); hospitality-specific attribute affecting value.

id.description: Unique identifier of this per-asset comp-entity row within the sale comp.

notes.description: Collection of free-text research notes attached to this comp-entity, often capturing per-asset deal context.

numberOfUnits.description: Unit count for the asset; multifamily/land attribute supporting price-per-unit metrics.

percentLeased.description: Share of the asset under lease at the time of sale; the occupancy/leasing profile is a key comp comparability dimension for income durability (leased differs from physically occupied).

propertyId.description: PropertyID added to enable searches by property/address without joining to Property or CondoUnit+Property by sale entity type, dramatically improving comp retrieval speed.

totalSquarefeet.description: Total square footage of the asset; size denominator for price/SF and multifamily/land sizing.

noteType.description: A pre-defined categorization of note text, typically referred to as 'Notes' in CRM Enterprise.

value.description: The body (free-text content) of the note.

marketImprovementValue.description: Assessor's market value of the buildings and other improvements.

marketLandValue.description: Assessor's market value of the land.

marketTotalValue.description: Assessor's total market value (land plus improvements).

marketImprovementPercent.description: Share of the assessor's total market value attributed to improvements.

assessments.description: Collection of per-document assessment records (assessed/market improvement, land, and total values) rolled up to support comp valuation.

cityTax.description: City-level transfer tax paid on the conveyance; additional tax-stamp basis that can corroborate price.

countyId.description: County whose recorder/assessor holds the document; scopes the document number, which is only unique within a county. Join to county geography on the ID.

dateFiled.description: Date the transfer document was recorded/filed with the county; recording date for the deed.

documentNumber.description: Normalized recording/document number identifying the deed in the county recorder's records, used to tie the sale to public records.

documentNumberRaw.description: Original unnormalized document number as recorded by the source, preserved alongside the cleaned documentNumber.

exciseNumber.description: Excise/recording reference number associated with the transfer tax payment on the document.

id.description: Unique identifier of the transfer (deed) document record underlying the sale comp.

isNonDisclosure.description: Whether the sale falls in a non-disclosure jurisdiction where price is not publicly recorded, explaining undisclosed/estimated prices.

isPrimaryDocument.description: Whether this is the primary deed for the sale comp (vs supporting/secondary documents), used to pick the authoritative conveyance.

legalDescription.description: Legal description of the land parcel conveyed by the deed, defining exactly what real property transferred.

noDocumentAvailable.description: Flag indicating no recorded transfer document is available for the sale, so deed-derived details cannot be sourced.

taxStampType.description: Type of documentary tax stamp on the deed, indicating the basis/jurisdiction of the transfer tax.

transferTax.description: Transfer (county/state) tax paid on the recorded conveyance; can be used to infer or corroborate undisclosed sale price.

assessment.description: Value-typed assessed-valuation breakdown from the assessor (improved value, land value, total value, and derived improved-to-total ratio); the tax-roll basis of value for the parcel.

assessmentSourceType.description: Code identifying the origin of the assessment data (e.g. which assessor/tax source supplied the valuation), used to gauge provenance and reliability of the figures.

assessmentYear.description: Tax assessment year the assessed valuation figures apply to, anchoring the assessor's improved/land/total values to a specific assessment roll period.

id.description: Unique identifier for the transfer-document assessment record, which captures the assessor/tax valuation tied to a property's deed transfer within a commercial sale comp.

isPartialAPNSale.description: Flag indicating the sale transaction covered only part of the assessor's parcel (APN) rather than the whole parcel, a comparability caveat when relating the assessment to the sale price.

marketAssessment.description: Value-typed market-valuation breakdown (market improvement, land, total value, and derived improvement percent) representing the assessor's estimated market value as distinct from the assessed/taxable value.

parcelNumber.description: County assessor's parcel number (APN) for the land parcel covered by this transfer document, tying the assessment to public tax/ownership records; APNs are unique only within a county.

propertyTax.description: Annual property tax amount levied on the parcel per the assessor record; a financial datum used in income/expense analysis of the comp and in comparability adjustments.

propertyTaxYear.description: Tax year the propertyTax amount applies to, anchoring the levied tax figure to a specific billing period.

verificationField.description: Code identifying which specific sale-comp field this verification record pertains to, enabling field-level tracking of what data has been verified and from which source in the comp research workflow.

verificationSource.description: Code identifying the source through which a field of the commercial sale comp was verified (e.g. broker, buyer, seller, public record), recording how the deal datum was confirmed in the field-level verification workflow.
